% Generated from map example rx-relink (Link refresh, a waiting thread that always faces a fresh end). Do not edit.
\leavevmode\par\nobreak\noindent
\begin{minipage}{\linewidth}
\begin{maplisting}
refresh = !(f = λ⟨w, k⟩. \lstkw{let} ⟨c, c′⟩ = \lstkw{new} \lstkw{in}
                     \lstkw{let} ∗ = \lstkw{link} ⟨w, c⟩ \lstkw{in}          \lstcmt{-- the waiting end now faces c′}
                     \lstkw{let} k = \lstkw{send} ⟨∗, k⟩ \lstkw{in}           \lstcmt{-- one step on another channel}
                     (\lstkw{force} f) ⟨c′, k⟩)
sink    = !(f = λk. \lstkw{let} ⟨u, k⟩ = \lstkw{recv} k \lstkw{in} \lstkw{let} ∗ = u \lstkw{in} (\lstkw{force} f) k)
main = \lstkw{let} ⟨w, w′⟩ = \lstkw{new} \lstkw{in} \lstkw{let} ⟨k, k′⟩ = \lstkw{new} \lstkw{in}
       \lstkw{let} ∗ = \lstkw{spawn} (λ_. \lstkw{close} w′) \lstkw{in}              \lstcmt{-- waits forever}
       \lstkw{let} ∗ = \lstkw{spawn} (λ_. (\lstkw{force} sink) k′) \lstkw{in}
       (\lstkw{force} refresh) ⟨w, k⟩
\end{maplisting}
\end{minipage}
